common.--font-sans: "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
common.--head-font: "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

css: & .am-panel { outline: 1px solid var(--line); outline-offset: -6px; } & .am-panel-head { background: var(--head-bg); border-bottom: 0; } & .am-panel-head h2 { color: var(--head-fg); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } & .am-panel-id { background: transparent; color: var(--head-fg); border-inline-end: var(--bw) solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--head-fg) 45%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; } & .am-panel-meta { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--head-fg) 68%, transparent); } & .am-md th { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-bottom: 0; } & .am-md td { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-2); } & .am-md strong { background: none; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: inset 0 -0.28em 0 var(--accent-bg); } & .am-callout { border-inline-start-width: 6px; } & .am-callout--ok { border-inline-start-color: var(--ink); } & .am-callout--warn { border-inline-start-color: var(--ink-3); background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--paper) 0 7px, var(--fill) 7px 14px); } & .am-callout--err { border-inline-start-width: 10px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink); } & .am-status--ok { color: var(--ink); } & .am-status--warn { color: var(--ink-3); } & .am-status--no { color: var(--ink); } & .am-status--no .am-status-icon { font-weight: 900; } & .am-head h1 { font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } & .am-colophon { font-family: var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
